notes: URL-pre-filter workaround on a SuccessFactors board. The board exposes no location select, combobox, or checkbox facet — only three bare text inputs (q, title, date), i.e. the C2 shape — so the filter is carried in the URL via locationsearch=costa+rica. Despite being a free-text parameter this behaves as a structured lookup, not naive string matching: SuccessFactors resolves the term to a location entity (page title becomes 'Costa Rica - Terumo BCT, Inc. Jobs') and matches rows whose displayed location reads 'Cartago, CR' — the literal string 'Costa Rica' never appears in a row. Cross-checked against the structured country facet ?optionsFacetsDD_country=CR (the Coloplast-shape parameter on the same platform): both return the identical 5 jobs, and both report 'Results 1 - 5 of 5, Page 1 of 1', so the filtered set is complete and single-page. hooks.filter_already_applied=True guards the pre-applied filter against the agent typing into the search inputs; with it the live run settles in 2 steps. expected_unfiltered_count=5 is unfiltered relative to the ship-path URL, not the full board. The queue's original sample_job_url (/job/Pinares-Sr-Software-Systems-Engineer-R&D/1361772900/) was closed by integration time and appears under neither filter; the entry ships a live sample instead, though LinkRule(path_prefix='/job') means the derivation is overridden either way (the title-in-path shape derives a per-job prefix).
